title: A table of boundary slopes of Montesinos knots
note: arXiv:math/9901120v3 (revised June 2010). Owner upload 2026-09-07. Corrects Hatcher–Oertel's table of boundary slopes for Montesinos knots of at most 10 crossings; notation follows [HO] and Rolfsen. Used here for the 5_2 = K(3/7) row, slopes {0, 4, 10}: an independent held source, with Rolfsen's convention, that the two-bridge triangulation derived from the Farey word RL (slopes {-10,-4,0}) is the mirror of the Rolfsen 5_2 (qou-lrvc). The Topology placement is recalled and not verified in-sandbox.
